dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a pronounced concave spline curvature with the maximum inflection point located in the lower half of the fin's height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is rounded with an obtuse shape classification; there is no sharp angular vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour slopes at a steep angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin's maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.1 times its maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents a smooth, continuous convex arc extending from the blowhole to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: The rostrum is short and robust, with a pixel length roughly equal to 1.2 times its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A distinct inflection point is visible where the melon meets the rostrum, forming an interior angle of approximately 135 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible cluster of parallel linear 'rake mark' scars on the dorsal-lateral surface posterior to the blowhole; scattered pale, circular depigmentation spots on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark grey dorsal cape creates a high-contrast boundary with the lighter lateral coloration; the blowhole and eye are clearly defined.
